project.name: anomaly-metric-creator
project.description: Synthetic IoT-style metric log generator that produces deterministic, second-by-second CSV telemetry for a 13-component SaaS stack with built-in anomalies, cascading failures, a directed topology coupling graph, and optional OpenTelemetry/OTLP emission.

nodes.name: test_registry.py
nodes.summary: Lockstep regression checks between the production `COMPONENTS` / `DEFAULT_METRICS_PER_COMPONENT` / `SCENARIOS` registries and the `conftest.COMPONENT_FIELDS` / `DEFAULT_METRIC_COUNT` test catalog — drift in either direction fails here.

nodes.name: test_reporting_artifacts.py
nodes.summary: Asserts that `metric_report.log` and `metric_traces.jsonl` align with `anomalies.csv` and that `write_reporting_artifacts` rejects rows missing required fields.

nodes.name: test_run_capture_helper.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the `run_capture` conftest helper itself — pins the default `--interval-seconds 60`, the `interval_seconds=None` opt-out, and rejection of duplicate `--interval-seconds` in `extra_args`.

nodes.name: _schema_interval
nodes.summary: Reads `metadata.interval_seconds` from a captured run's `schema.json`; the canonical assertion target for verifying which interval `run_capture` actually used.

nodes.name: test_schema_file.py
nodes.summary: Golden-hash and structural coverage for `schema.json` — locks the v2 byte representation at 1d and 7d, asserts the document carries every required section, and pins the per-component `dimensions` block under multi-instance fan-out.

nodes.name: one_day_schema_run_n3
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture producing a 1-day N=3 run with the `schema` emit token, exercising the dim-aware `components[].dimensions` schema block.

nodes.name: seven_day_schema_run_n3
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture producing a 7-day N=3 run for the long-duration dimension-aware schema golden hash.

nodes.name: test_shapes.py
nodes.summary: Direct numeric coverage of every anomaly span shape (`ramp_linear`, `ramp_exp`, `sustained`, `sawtooth`, `sine`) — endpoint values, multiplier ranges, period correctness, and the override generator dispatch.

nodes.name: _apply_anomaly_shape
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper that invokes the production `_apply_anomaly_shape` helper on a constructed spec so each shape can be tested in isolation from the full generation pipeline.

nodes.name: _span_rows
nodes.summary: Computes the list of (row_index, t_within) tuples a span anomaly covers for a given `duration_seconds` and `--interval-seconds`, mirroring the generator's row-mapping math.

nodes.name: test_topology_fanout.py
nodes.summary: Realistic-mode topology coverage: byte-parity between the no-flag default and explicit `--topology-mode realistic`, plus correlation lifts on every front-half fan-out edge (loadbalancer→apigateway, apigateway→{auth,cache,db}).

nodes.name: _aligned_columns
nodes.summary: Reads source and target metric columns from per-component CSVs, intersects on timestamp, and returns aligned float arrays for Pearson correlation assertions.

nodes.name: test_topology_llm.py
nodes.summary: Coverage for Phase 5 `apigateway → llm_analytics` coupling and saturation: Pearson correlation on `input_tokens_per_sec`, mean lifts on latency/error columns, scenario non-masking, and byte-identity with the no-flag default.

nodes.name: _aligned_columns
nodes.summary: LLM-test variant of the column-alignment helper, returning timestamp-matched numeric arrays from a pair of per-component CSVs.

nodes.name: _compute_llm_exclusion_windows
nodes.summary: Builds the list of (start, end) timestamp ranges to exclude from the LLM coupling correlation — every LLM-related anomaly window padded so the natural-load correlation is not polluted by anomaly spikes.

nodes.name: realistic_full_metrics_one_day_llm
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture producing a 1-day realistic-mode run with `--metrics-per-component 10` so `p95_llm_latency_ms` is on disk for the supplemental-column assertions.

nodes.name: test_topology_multi_instance.py
nodes.summary: Phase 8 per-instance topology coverage: validates the matched-cardinality 1:1 routing (`_matched_cardinality`), per-pod isolation under saturation, and the divergence-detection logic inside `generate_component`.

nodes.name: synthetic_n3_run
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture that runs the generator with a hand-crafted N=3 setup designed to exercise the per-instance topology dispatch (matched cardinalities across upstream/downstream pods).

nodes.name: _instance_block_rows
nodes.summary: Reads the per-instance row block from a long-form per-component CSV — used by per-pod isolation assertions to compare instance K's rows independently of siblings.

nodes.name: test_topology_saturation.py
nodes.summary: Phase 4 saturation coverage: validates the logistic curve in `_apply_saturation`, per-edge bounds (latency multiplier in [1, 1+gain], error offset in [0, gain]), realistic-vs-independent CSV byte equivalence under the no-flag default, and parameter validation.

nodes.name: _aligned_columns
nodes.summary: Saturation-test variant of the column-alignment helper used to compare downstream latency/error columns against the upstream load they depend on.

nodes.name: independent_one_day_sat
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture producing a 1-day run under the deprecated `--topology-mode independent` alias for the byte-parity baseline.

nodes.name: test_validate_output.py
nodes.summary: Exhaustive coverage of the `--validate-output` standalone mode — every check function (required files, no-unknown-files, sorted manifest, row counts, timestamp coverage, cell ranges, derivations, long-form dimensions, topology coupling) with both happy-path and corruption-injection cases.

nodes.name: schema_run
nodes.summary: Parametrizable fixture that produces a run with `schema` in the emit-selection at a caller-chosen `--duration-days` — the shared input for most validator tests.

nodes.name: _classify
nodes.summary: Groups validator stderr lines into a `{check_name -> [messages]}` dict so per-check assertions can target a single violation class.

nodes.name: schema_run_n3
nodes.summary: N=3 multi-instance counterpart to `schema_run` — produces a dim-aware dataset for the Phase 8 long-form dimension validator checks.

nodes.name: one_day_run_n3
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture producing a 1-day N=3 run consumed by dim-aware validator assertions that don't need the schema emit toggle.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Pytest fixtures and shared test helpers — lazily loads the `anomaly-metric-creator.py` module via `_load_amc`, defines the central `run_capture` helper that invokes `main()` with sane defaults, and exposes session-scoped fixtures for 1-day, 7-day, and N=3 datasets to keep suite wall-time bounded.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `importlib.util.spec_from_file_location` for the hyphenated module name; the `_load_amc` memoization is the canonical entry point for fresh-module needs (per `amc-no-direct-spec-load` pre-commit guard).

nodes.name: _load_amc
nodes.summary: Memoized loader for the hyphenated `anomaly-metric-creator.py` module via `spec_from_file_location`; the single sanctioned path for tests that need a fresh module instance.

nodes.name: run_capture
nodes.summary: Central test driver that invokes the generator's `main()` with `--interval-seconds 60` (override-able), capturing stdout/stderr and writing into a per-test output directory; every multi-file test fixture funnels through this helper.

nodes.name: _isolate_otel_env_session
nodes.summary: Auto-applied session fixture that scrubs `OTEL_*` environment variables so OTLP-aware tests do not leak collector endpoints into unrelated runs.

nodes.name: one_day_full_metrics_run
nodes.summary: Session-scoped fixture that produces a 1-day run with `--metrics-per-component MAX` so supplemental-metric tests share one expensive dataset.

nodes.name: one_day_independent_run
nodes.summary: Session-scoped fixture that produces a 1-day run under the deprecated `--topology-mode independent` alias, used by tests asserting pre-flag-day byte parity.

nodes.name: n3_one_day_dataset_dir
nodes.summary: Session-scoped 1-day dataset with `--instances-per-component 3`; the ~1.3 GB dataset is shared across every multi-instance test file to keep peak RSS bounded.

nodes.name: declared_specs
nodes.summary: Flattens every `SCENARIOS` entry's primary and cascade specs into a list of (component, metric, time_offset) tuples for catalog-coverage assertions.

nodes.name: primary_spec_lookup
nodes.summary: Builds a `{(component, metric, time_offset) -> spec_dict}` index over every primary spec so tests can look up declarative shape/duration metadata by location.

nodes.name: read_component_rows
nodes.summary: CSV reader helper that returns a list of dict rows from a per-component CSV in an output directory; used by correctness checks that need cell-level access.

nodes.name: natural_band
nodes.summary: Computes the empirical mean/std band for a given (component, metric) column over the natural (no-anomaly) baseline; the reference distribution behind every value-band sanity test.

nodes.name: test_cli.py
nodes.summary: Subprocess-level CLI smoke tests covering `parse_args` flag validation, mutually exclusive combinations, help text contents, and end-to-end run success for representative flag bundles; the broadest single test file in the suite at ~1.6k lines.

nodes.name: test_combine.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end tests for the `combine_logs` / `combine_logs_unified` writers, covering both the wide layout (single-instance, byte-identical to legacy) and the long layout (multi-instance fan-out via `--instances-per-component`).

nodes.name: combined_dir
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture that runs the generator with `--combine` and a synthetic extra-component CSV planted on disk to exercise the autodiscovery branch.

nodes.name: _run_combine_subprocess
nodes.summary: Spawns the script as a real subprocess with `--combine-only` to verify the early-return branch bypasses pre-clean and schema regeneration.

nodes.name: n3_one_day_combine_run
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture producing a 1-day N=3 multi-instance combine run; the dedicated dataset for long-layout combine assertions.

nodes.name: test_correctness.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end correctness checks on generated CSVs — row counts, drop-rate tolerance, timestamp coverage, value-band sanity, clip_min invariants, derived-metric consistency (`cacheservice.hit_ratio`), and scenarios=all byte-parity with the no-flag default.

nodes.name: _assert_row_count_within_tolerance
nodes.summary: Asserts CSV row count sits inside an 8-sigma tolerance band around the expected drop count, mirroring the validator's under-emission check.

nodes.name: _assert_value_band_sanity
nodes.summary: Per-metric distribution check that asserts cell values stay inside a generous mean ± k·std band, excluding rows known to fall inside anomaly windows.

nodes.name: _assert_clip_min_invariant
nodes.summary: Confirms that every metric declaring a `clip_min` in MetricSpec never falls below that floor on any emitted CSV row.

nodes.name: _assert_cacheservice_hit_ratio_consistent
nodes.summary: Verifies the cacheservice `hit_ratio` column is recomputed from `cache_hits` and `cache_misses` on every row, so anomalies on the derived column are correctly overwritten by the derivation pass.

nodes.name: one_day_interval5_run
nodes.summary: Session-scoped fixture producing a 1-day run at `--interval-seconds 5` to exercise the row-rounding logic for sub-minute intervals.

nodes.name: test_determinism.py
nodes.summary: Two-test sanity check: identical seeds produce byte-identical output, and importing the module does not trigger CSV generation (the `__main__` guard works).

nodes.name: test_emit_selection_hygiene.py
nodes.summary: Verifies `_pre_clean_output_dir` deletes stale artifacts when `--emit-selection`, `--components`, or `--combine` shrink between runs, preserving idempotence and leaving unknown files untouched.

nodes.name: test_gauges_file.py
nodes.summary: Locked SHA-256 golden hashes plus structural assertions for `gauges.csv` in both the 4-column dimensionless layout (1d and 7d) and the 10-column dimensioned long layout (1d N=3), the file-format peer of the OTEL gauge stream.

nodes.name: n3_one_day_gauges_run
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture producing a 1-day N=3 run with `gauges` in the emit-selection so the long-layout golden-hash test has a dedicated input.

nodes.name: test_instances_per_component.py
nodes.summary: Multi-instance fan-out coverage: validates `--instances-per-component N`, the long-form CSV header, locked N=3 SHA-256 hashes at 1d and 7d, dimension prefix invariants, and parser-level mutually-exclusive guards (DST splice, `--instance-config`).

nodes.name: _run
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper around `run_capture` that asserts the CLI exited with status 0 before returning the captured stdout/stderr/output dir.

nodes.name: _invoke
nodes.summary: Subprocess-level invocation helper used by the parser tests that need a real argv parse + exit-code assertion without going through `main()` in-process.

nodes.name: test_multiday_cascades.py
nodes.summary: Multi-day scenario coverage: asserts the 7-day run materializes every multi-day scenario's primary + cascade specs and that the 1-day run drops them with the expected stderr WARNING.

nodes.name: _day_index
nodes.summary: Helper that converts an anomaly's recorded timestamp into a 0-based day index relative to `START`, used to group manifest rows by simulated day.

nodes.name: test_otel_gauges.py
nodes.summary: OTLP gauge-stream coverage: JSON and protobuf payload builders, per-row dimension attribute emission (Phase 6), the `_iter_component_rows` 4-tuple contract for dimensioned and dimensionless CSVs, and an end-to-end stream against a stand-up mock collector.

nodes.name: _MockCollector
nodes.summary: In-process `BaseHTTPRequestHandler` subclass used by the live-stream tests to record incoming OTLP/HTTP gauge POSTs for inspection.

nodes.name: _entry
nodes.summary: Builder for a synthetic gauge batch entry — used by the payload-builder unit tests to construct hand-crafted inputs without driving a full CSV run.

nodes.name: _decode_gauge_requests
nodes.summary: Decodes the raw POST bodies captured by the mock collector — splits into JSON vs protobuf paths and surfaces per-datapoint attribute dicts for downstream assertions.

nodes.name: .pre-commit-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Declares two pre-commit hooks: an upstream ruff hook scoped to tests/ enforcing F401 (unused imports), and a local amc-no-direct-spec-load hook that runs tools/check_amc_module_load.py to forbid duplicate spec_from_file_location loads of anomaly-metric-creator.py outside conftest.py.
nodes.languageNotes: ruff rev is pinned to match the ruff==X.Y.Z entry in pyproject.toml's [project.optional-dependencies].dev so local and hook binaries resolve identically.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Minimal pointer document redirecting agents to CLAUDE.md for the architectural guide and to README.md for user-facing CLI / catalog reference. Explicitly disallows reintroducing parallel agent content here.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative agent / architecture guide for the synthetic metric generator: core generation pattern, RunContext threading, multi-instance fan-out, topology-coupling math, saturation feedback, scenario registry invariants, schema document, validator semantics, and a 13-section pre-PR checklist.
nodes.languageNotes: Single source of truth for invariants enforced at import time by _validate_scenarios_registry and _validate_topology; phased history (phases 1-9) is documented inline alongside the live behavior.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: User-facing reference: install instructions, CLI flag table, output-file inventory, per-component metric catalog, topology graph v1, application flow, anomaly / scenario catalog, parallel-test execution, and test-hygiene lint section.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Python project manifest declaring numpy / opentelemetry-proto / protobuf runtime deps, optional [yaml] and [dev] extras (with pinned ruff==0.15.13), pytest config (xdist -n 4 --dist loadfile, required_plugins, full_resolution marker), and ruff F401 lint selection targeted at py311.
nodes.languageNotes: addopts uses --dist loadfile so the ~1.3 GB N=3 dataset fixture is instantiated at most once per worker file; required_plugins surfaces a clear error when pytest-xdist is missing.

nodes.name: anomaly-metric-creator.py
nodes.summary: Monolithic synthetic IoT metric generator: declares 13-component MetricSpec/Scenario/Edge/Instance registries, implements vectorized per-component CSV generation with anomaly injection, topology coupling, saturation feedback, multi-instance fan-out, and OTLP streaming. Single 10808-line module exposes parse_args/main as the entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: Single Python module mixing dataclasses, module-level registries (COMPONENTS, SCENARIOS, TOPOLOGY, INSTANCES, DERIVATIONS), vectorized numpy generation, and a large argparse CLI; import-time validators enforce schema invariants across registries.

nodes.name: RunContext
nodes.summary: Per-run mutable container threading the RandomState RNG, accumulated anomalies list, cascading anomalies dict, and per-component Instance lists through generate_component without module-level globals.

nodes.name: MetricSpec
nodes.summary: Declarative spec for a single metric column: base/std for natural distribution, multiplier/additive callables for seasonal shape, clip_min, and schema metadata (unit, semantic_type, min/max, dtype, derivation) consumed by schema.json and the validator.

nodes.name: Instance
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass naming a single emitting replica via optional id/host/pod/az/region/tenant dimensions; the active per-run list controls long-form CSV layout dispatch and OTLP datapoint attribute emission.

nodes.name: SaturationParams
nodes.summary: Frozen logistic-response parameters (midpoint, steepness, latency_gain, error_gain) attached to a topology Edge to drive load-driven latency multiplier and error offset on downstream metrics.

nodes.name: Edge
nodes.summary: Frozen directed edge in the TOPOLOGY graph carrying target component, constant or callable weight, optional SaturationParams, optional signal callable (required iff weight is callable), and optional validator correlation_threshold override.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Catalog entry bundling slug, severity, days_required, category, components_touched tuple, primary_specs and cascade_specs lists; the import-time validator enforces invariants across all five.

nodes.name: _IdentityKey
nodes.summary: Object identity wrapper used as a hashable dict key so the generator-meta cache can key on a generator function's id() even when the function itself is unhashable.

nodes.name: _derive_cacheservice
nodes.summary: Recomputes the cacheservice.hit_ratio column from cache_hits and cache_misses post-anomaly so anomalies on the ratio cannot diverge from the underlying counters.

nodes.name: _is_anonymous_instance_list
nodes.summary: Dispatch predicate detecting the single-anonymous-Instance() default; the long-form CSV writer, schema dimension block, and gauges writer all key off this to preserve byte-identical N=1 output.

nodes.name: _natural_column
nodes.summary: Vectorized natural-value generator producing one MetricSpec column: (base + std*randn) * multiplier(ts, elapsed) + additive(ts, elapsed); accepts optional baseline_override, latency_factor, error_offset, and pre-drawn noise for topology integration.

nodes.name: _resolve_instance_filter
nodes.summary: Resolves a Phase 4 instance_filter (None, iterable of ids, or callable predicate) against the active Instance list, returning the indices the anomaly override applies to; emits a stderr WARNING on zero matches.

nodes.name: generate_component
nodes.summary: Central per-component writer: builds the timestamp array, applies natural columns plus optional per-instance topology arrays, overrides anomaly cells, runs derivations, snapshots upstream load, rounds dtype=int columns, emits packet drops, and writes the wide-or-long CSV. 686 lines of vectorized numpy.

nodes.name: _format_metric_suffix
nodes.summary: Joins per-metric pre-formatted string columns into the comma-separated metric suffix written after the timestamp (and dimension prefix) in each CSV row.

nodes.name: _format_csv_row_block
nodes.summary: Builds the per-row text block for one Instance's CSV slice from kept timestamps, metric suffix, and dimension prefix; routes through _splice_dst_artifact when dst_inject_day > 0.

nodes.name: _splice_dst_artifact
nodes.summary: Splices the DST fall-back hour duplicate into a row block at the requested day, producing the non-monotonic timestamps that the inject_dst_artifact_day scenario relies on.

nodes.name: _resolve_anomaly_value
nodes.summary: Computes the override value an anomaly spec writes at one row, dispatching on shape (step/ramp/sustained/sawtooth/sine) and feeding the generator callable via the canonical 2/3/5-positional dispatch rule.

nodes.name: _generator_meta
nodes.summary: Introspects an anomaly generator callable's signature into (required_positional, max_positional, has_var_args, fixed_positional_count) so the dispatcher and validator can enforce the canonical 2/3/5-arg call shapes.

nodes.name: _cached_generator_meta
nodes.summary: Memoizes _generator_meta on the generator's _IdentityKey so the dispatcher avoids re-introspecting the same lambda thousands of times across rows.

nodes.name: _call_generator_within_span
nodes.summary: Invokes a span-shape anomaly generator with the canonical 5-positional or 2-positional shape based on its arity meta; rejects mis-binding cases (e.g. *args with fixed_positional_count > 2) explicitly.

nodes.name: _format_fixed3
nodes.summary: Vectorized format of a numpy float array to fixed 3-decimal-place strings, matching the legacy CSV precision contract.

nodes.name: _build_timestamp_arrays
nodes.summary: Pre-builds the (datetime_array, elapsed_seconds_array, formatted_string_array) tuple once per run so every generate_component call shares the same time axis.

nodes.name: register_cascade
nodes.summary: Helper for tests to append a cascade spec into a caller-supplied cascade_registry dict; production code reads cascades directly from Scenario.cascade_specs and does not call this function.

nodes.name: _llm_business_hours
nodes.summary: Multiplier callable for LLM-related metrics shaping a higher-during-business-hours load envelope on the daily timestamp axis.

nodes.name: _validate_metric_spec_schema_metadata
nodes.summary: Import-time validator enforcing the MetricSpec schema metadata vocabulary: semantic_type in {counter,gauge,ratio,rate}, dtype in {float,int}, finite numeric min/max with min<=max.

nodes.name: _component_metric_base
nodes.summary: Look-up helper returning a component's MetricSpec.base for a given metric, used by the topology coupling math to normalize upstream contributions to natural baselines.

nodes.name: _cache_miss_ratio_signal
nodes.summary: Edge signal callable computing per-row cache miss ratio cache_misses / (cache_hits + cache_misses) from cacheservice's captured columns; powers the callable-weight cacheservice → database edge.

nodes.name: _validate_saturation_params
nodes.summary: Validates SaturationParams field types and ranges (positive midpoint/steepness, non-negative gains, no bool, no NaN/inf) at both import time and inside _apply_saturation so direct callers cannot smuggle in invalid params.

nodes.name: _validate_topology
nodes.summary: Import-time validator for the TOPOLOGY graph: enforces source keys in COMPONENTS, target keys in COMPONENTS, weight/signal pairing rules, callable weight smoke tests with a 3-element ndarray probe, signal callable probe with a captured-column dict, correlation_threshold ranges, and rejects cycles including self-loops.

nodes.name: _topology_generation_order
nodes.summary: Kahn-algorithm topological sort of the active components against the directed TOPOLOGY graph; ties break on COMPONENTS insertion order so realistic-mode generation order is deterministic.

nodes.name: _compose_topology_coupled_specs
nodes.summary: Rewrites a downstream component's load MetricSpec list under realistic mode: constant-weight edges contribute normalized (upstream/upstream_base)*downstream_base*w_norm, callable-weight edges add edge.weight(edge.signal(cols)), plus per-row coupling noise.

nodes.name: _apply_saturation
nodes.summary: Logistic-response transform: utilization = clip(upstream_load/midpoint, 0, max), logistic = sigmoid(steepness*(utilization-1)), returns (latency_multiplier, error_offset) pair scaled by per-edge gains.

nodes.name: _compose_topology_saturation_specs
nodes.summary: Sums incoming saturating contributions onto each downstream's latency-family and error-family MetricSpecs: multiplicative composition for latency_factor, additive for error_offset, baked into multiplier/additive closures.

nodes.name: _matched_cardinality
nodes.summary: Per-instance routing predicate: returns True when upstream and downstream instance counts match (1:1 per-pod routing) and False for uniform fan-out averaging.

nodes.name: _per_instance_upstream_view
nodes.summary: Builds the per-instance upstream column view a downstream pod consumes: 1:1 picks the matching pod's column, mismatched cardinalities fall back to mean of all upstream pods.

nodes.name: _compute_topology_arrays_per_instance
nodes.summary: Per-instance topology composer used when ctx.instances is non-anonymous: returns (coupling_by_instance, saturation_by_instance) arrays so each downstream pod sees its matched upstream pod's load, while sharing RNG noise draws across symmetric pods to preserve byte-identical CSV output.

nodes.name: _arrays_equal_dict
nodes.summary: Per-instance divergence check: returns True when two dicts of metric->ndarray are element-wise equal so generate_component can collapse to the shared natural-draw fast path.

nodes.name: _sat_tuples_equal_dict
nodes.summary: Equality check on dicts of metric -> (latency_factor, error_offset) tuples, used alongside _arrays_equal_dict to detect when all per-instance saturation arrays are identical.

nodes.name: _validate_scenario_spec
nodes.summary: Per-spec import-time validator enforcing required keys, metric in COMPONENTS catalog, callable generator with canonical 2/3/5-arg shape, finite non-negative non-bool time_offset, shape vocabulary, instance_filter forms, and cascade-vs-primary key restrictions. 318 lines of exhaustive checks.

nodes.name: _validate_scenarios_registry
nodes.summary: Walks every Scenario entry at import time: slug == dict key, severity in {low, medium, high}, days_required equals earliest spec day index, components_touched equals union of referenced components, delegates per-spec validation to _validate_scenario_spec.

nodes.name: _validate_derivations_registry
nodes.summary: Import-time check ensuring every DERIVATIONS key references a known component and every declared derivation metric is present in that component's MetricSpec catalog.

nodes.name: _validate_instance_list
nodes.summary: Validates one component's Instance list: shape (list of Instance), at most MAX_INSTANCES_PER_COMPONENT, unique non-None ids, all dimension fields are str-or-None and CSV-safe (no commas/newlines).

nodes.name: _validate_instances_registry
nodes.summary: Import-time validator for the module-level INSTANCES dict: every COMPONENTS key has a list, no extra keys, delegates per-list checks to _validate_instance_list.

nodes.name: _load_instance_config
nodes.summary: Loads --instance-config YAML/JSON file into a per-component Instance list, lazily importing PyYAML, wrapping YAML/JSON/OS errors as ValueError with the file path prefix and preserving line/column markers for debugging.

nodes.name: _resolve_effective_specs
nodes.summary: Trims each component's MetricSpec list to the first N entries per --metrics-per-component, producing the active spec dict the run will emit.

nodes.name: _filter_anomalies_for_emitted_metrics
nodes.summary: Drops anomaly specs whose metric was trimmed by --metrics-per-component (silent, intended) and raises ValueError on anomalies referencing metrics not in the full COMPONENTS catalog (typo guard).

nodes.name: _apply_signal_level_and_count
nodes.summary: Applies --signal-level severity gate and --anomaly-count sampling across the active scenarios, walking COMPONENTS order then per-component spec list order then cascade order so sampling stays seed-deterministic.

nodes.name: _resolve_scenarios
nodes.summary: Resolution pipeline: --scenarios allowlist -> --exclude-scenarios -> --signal-level -> --duration-days -> --components; emits one stderr WARNING per scenario dropped by severity or duration in sorted-slug order.

nodes.name: _apply_scenarios
nodes.summary: Flattens active Scenario entries into the per-run component_anomalies dict and cascading_anomalies dict; the single point that populates RunContext anomaly state.

nodes.name: _env_bool
nodes.summary: Parses a boolean environment variable accepting 1/true/yes/on (case-insensitive) with a fallback default; used by the OTEL feature flags.

nodes.name: parse_args
nodes.summary: Argparse-based CLI parser for all 30+ flags (--seed, --duration-days, --interval-seconds, --components, --scenarios/--exclude-scenarios, --signal-level, --anomaly-count, --metrics-per-component, --instances-per-component/--instance-config, --emit-selection, --combine/--combine-only, --validate-output, --topology-mode, --otel-*); enforces mutually-exclusive groups and cross-flag invariants. 665 lines.

nodes.name: discover_components
nodes.summary: Autodiscovers per-component CSV files in input_dir for the combine step, excluding anomalies.csv, gauges.csv, and prior combine outputs.

nodes.name: combine_logs_unified
nodes.summary: Combine step entry point: scans per-component CSV headers via _scan_component_csv_headers and dispatches to the wide-layout writer (default, dimensionless) or _write_combined_long_form (multi-instance dimensioned input).

nodes.name: _write_combined_long_form
nodes.summary: Long-form combine writer producing the 10-column timestamp/component/id/host/pod/az/region/tenant/metric/value layout via heapq.merge across per-(component, instance) iterators with deterministic (component, instance_id, metric) tie-break.

nodes.name: combine_logs
nodes.summary: Backwards-compatible combine entry that resolves the components allowlist (either explicit list or autodiscovery) and delegates to combine_logs_unified.

nodes.name: write_reporting_artifacts
nodes.summary: Writes the optional metric_report.log and metric_traces.jsonl artifacts driven by --emit-selection logs/traces flags.

nodes.name: _parse_csv_timestamp
nodes.summary: Parses a CSV timestamp string in the script's canonical %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f format into a datetime.

nodes.name: _dt_to_unix_nanos
nodes.summary: Converts a naive datetime to OTLP unix-nano integer timestamps, the time unit OTLP protobuf requires.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_trace_payload
nodes.summary: Builds the OTLP/JSON trace payload for an anomaly trace span: resource attributes, scope, span with start/end nanos and the canonical attribute set.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_trace_protobuf
nodes.summary: Protobuf peer of _build_otlp_trace_payload using the OTLP trace proto descriptors; the OTLP/HTTP+protobuf branch of --otel-protocol.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_metric_payload
nodes.summary: Builds an OTLP/JSON metric payload for an anomaly counter datapoint, attaching event.id/signal.type/metric.name/component plus any non-empty dimension attributes.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_metric_protobuf
nodes.summary: Protobuf peer of _build_otlp_metric_payload for the anomaly-counter signal under the protobuf transport.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_gauge_payload
nodes.summary: Builds an OTLP/JSON gauge payload from a batch of gauge datapoints, attaching metric.name/component/signal.type/dimension attributes onto each NumberDataPoint.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_gauge_protobuf
nodes.summary: Protobuf peer of _build_otlp_gauge_payload emitting the gauge metric batch via the OTLP metrics proto descriptors.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_log_payload
nodes.summary: OTLP/JSON log record builder used by stream_otel_signals when --otel-emit-logs is on.

nodes.name: _build_otlp_log_protobuf
nodes.summary: Protobuf peer of _build_otlp_log_payload for the OTLP/HTTP+protobuf transport.

nodes.name: _write_activity
nodes.summary: Append-only writer for ./otel-activity.log recording each OTLP request the streamer sent (event type, signal type, count, masked headers).

nodes.name: _verbose_body_repr
nodes.summary: Best-effort body repr for the OTEL activity log: JSON-decoded preview for JSON payloads, byte-length summary for protobuf.

nodes.name: _masked_headers
nodes.summary: Masks Authorization/x-api-key header values for the activity log so credentials never land in the audit trail.

nodes.name: stream_otel_signals
nodes.summary: Streams anomaly traces/metrics/logs to OTLP endpoints at the per-second pace dictated by --otel-speedup, honoring --otel-emit-traces/--otel-emit-metrics/--otel-emit-logs and --otel-max-events.

nodes.name: _iter_component_rows
nodes.summary: Yields (timestamp_str, component, [(metric_name, value)], dimensions) tuples from one per-component CSV; auto-detects the dimension prefix block via column ordering against _INSTANCE_DIMENSION_COLUMNS.

nodes.name: _ensure_long_form_fd_capacity
nodes.summary: Pre-flight check that raises RLIMIT_NOFILE soft limit to fit the per-(component, instance) handle fan-out before the long-form heapq.merge runs; no-ops on Windows.

nodes.name: _classify_component_csv_header
nodes.summary: Inspects a per-component CSV header to detect whether columns [1..7] are the canonical (id, host, pod, az, region, tenant) dimension prefix, returning a 'has_dims' classification used by combine and gauge writers.

nodes.name: _scan_component_csv_headers
nodes.summary: Walks per-component CSVs and returns the (component -> header-classification) mapping that drives the wide-vs-long combine and gauges layout dispatch.

nodes.name: _scan_instance_block_layout
nodes.summary: Single-pass dim-only scan of a long-form CSV recording each per-instance block's (dim_tuple, byte_start_offset) so the iterator can seek straight to it instead of re-reading preceding blocks.

nodes.name: _iter_component_instance_rows
nodes.summary: Per-(component, instance) row iterator for the long-form combine/gauges writers: seeks to start_offset and yields tuples until the dim prefix changes.

nodes.name: write_gauges_csv
nodes.summary: File peer of stream_otel_gauges: merges per-component CSVs chronologically into gauges.csv, dispatching to 4-column or 10-column layout based on dim-aware header inspection.

nodes.name: stream_otel_gauges
nodes.summary: Streams per-component CSV rows as OTLP gauge datapoints batched by --otel-batch-seconds; mirrors write_gauges_csv but ships over HTTP and silently skips unparseable float cells.

nodes.name: _metric_spec_to_schema_entry
nodes.summary: Serializes one MetricSpec into a schema.json component entry: name/unit/semantic_type/dtype/min_value/max_value/derivation.

nodes.name: _saturation_params_to_schema_entry
nodes.summary: Serializes a SaturationParams into the schema.json {midpoint, steepness, latency_gain, error_gain} dict.

nodes.name: _edge_to_schema_entry
nodes.summary: Serializes one topology Edge into a schema.json entry: target, weight (numeric or 'callable'), saturation, correlation_threshold.

nodes.name: _component_dimensions_schema_entry
nodes.summary: Builds the optional per-component dimensions block for schema.json: emits {axes, cardinality} when any instance carries a non-None dimension field; returns None for the single-anonymous-Instance default so v1 schema bytes stay unchanged.

nodes.name: _serialize_topology
nodes.summary: Serializes the TOPOLOGY constant into schema.json's topology section, filtering edges whose source or target are outside the active component set and sorting target lists deterministically.

nodes.name: write_schema_json
nodes.summary: Writes the byte-deterministic schema.json (sort_keys, fixed indent, trailing newline): schema_version, metadata, per-component metric metadata with optional dimensions, files list, topology section. Single source of truth for --validate-output.

nodes.name: _load_schema_document
nodes.summary: Loads and version-checks schema.json: rejects unknown schema_version values outright so v1 docs fail under a v2 reader and vice versa.

nodes.name: _validate_no_unknown_files
nodes.summary: Validator step: every file in output_dir must be declared in schema.files (schema.json itself is always allowed).

nodes.name: _validate_anomalies_sorted
nodes.summary: Validator step: anomalies.csv rows are non-decreasing by timestamp.

nodes.name: _validate_component_row_count
nodes.summary: Validator step: per-component CSV row count is <= rows_per_component plus DST splice extras, with an 8-sigma under-emission band; both bounds are multiplied by dimension cardinality when the schema declares dimensions.

nodes.name: _validate_component_timestamp_coverage
nodes.summary: Validator step: every row's timestamp falls inside [START, START + total_seconds).

nodes.name: _validate_component_cells
nodes.summary: Validator step: header order matches MetricSpec sequence, every cell parses as float, ranges (min/max), dtype=int wholeness within 3-decimal CSV precision, semantic_type counter/rate >= 0. Skips dim cells under dimensioned long-form headers.

nodes.name: _validate_component_derivations
nodes.summary: Validator step: for every metric declaring a derivation, recompute it from source columns via the _RECOMPUTERS dispatch table and assert agreement within _VALIDATE_DERIVATION_TOLERANCE.

nodes.name: _recompute_cacheservice
nodes.summary: Dispatched recomputer for cacheservice derivations (hit_ratio from cache_hits/cache_misses); raises KeyError on unknown metrics so dispatch-table drift fails loudly.

nodes.name: _read_component_metric_column
nodes.summary: Reads a (timestamp, value) sequence for one metric from a per-component CSV; collapses per-instance duplicates to the mean per timestamp so the dim-aware long-form CSV stays monotonic on the timestamp axis.

nodes.name: _read_component_metric_column_per_instance
nodes.summary: Per-instance reader returning (timestamp, value) sequences indexed by instance block, used by _validate_topology_coupling_per_instance to verify 1:1 per-pod Pearson correlations.

nodes.name: _read_anomaly_exclusion_windows
nodes.summary: Parses anomalies.csv into [(start, end, component, metric)] windows the topology correlation validator subtracts from the row population before computing Pearson.

nodes.name: _filter_windows_for_pair
nodes.summary: Filters anomaly windows to those whose (component, metric) is either the source canonical, target canonical, or any other upstream contributor for this edge so cross-coupled anomaly bleed is properly excluded.

nodes.name: _compute_anomaly_keep_mask
nodes.summary: Builds a boolean keep-mask over timestamps that drops rows inside any of the (start, end) exclusion windows via a forward-sweep over the monotonic timestamp axis.

nodes.name: _apply_anomaly_exclusion
nodes.summary: Applies the keep-mask from _compute_anomaly_keep_mask to a (timestamps, values) pair, returning the anomaly-clean rows used in the topology correlation check.

nodes.name: _validate_topology_coupling
nodes.summary: Phase 7 topology coupling validator: per edge in schema.topology, computes Pearson(source canonical load, target canonical load) excluding anomaly windows; flags edges below per-edge correlation_threshold under realistic mode. Skips callable-weight edges, independent-mode runs, schemas without topology, and pairs with <100 aligned rows.

nodes.name: _validate_topology_coupling_per_instance
nodes.summary: Phase 8 per-instance companion to _validate_topology_coupling: for matched-cardinality dim-aware schemas, verifies Pearson(source.iK, target.iK) >= threshold per pod pair so mis-routed pod load surfaces as a dedicated violation.

nodes.name: _resolve_edge_correlation_threshold
nodes.summary: Returns the per-edge correlation_threshold from schema.topology, falling back to _TOPOLOGY_DEFAULT_CORRELATION_THRESHOLD (0.85) when the edge entry leaves the field null.

nodes.name: _schema_has_any_dimensions
nodes.summary: Returns True when any component in schema.components declares a non-empty dimensions block; mirrors the writer's any-of dispatch predicate so validator and writer cannot drift.

nodes.name: _validate_long_form_dimensions
nodes.summary: Phase 8 validator step: when any component declares dimensions, verifies gauges.csv and combined_metrics_unified.csv carry the 10-column long-form header. No-op for dimensionless schemas.

nodes.name: validate_output
nodes.summary: Top-level --validate-output entry: loads schema.json, dispatches every validator step over the schema's component list, returns the aggregated violation list for the CLI to format and exit on.

nodes.name: _collect_emitted_filenames
nodes.summary: Computes the sorted list of artifact filenames this run will emit, driven by --emit-selection, components, and --combine; single source of truth shared between schema.files, _pre_clean_output_dir, and the Done summary line.

nodes.name: _pre_clean_output_dir
nodes.summary: Deletes any file from a prior run into the output dir that the current run will not regenerate, using _EMIT_ARTIFACT_FILES + _COMBINE_OUTPUT_FILENAME as the registry. Idempotent; never touches the --combine-only branch.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Top-level CLI entry: parses args, branches on --combine-only / --validate-output / default generation, builds RunContext + Instance map, resolves scenarios, walks components in topology order under realistic mode, calls generate_component per component, then emits combine/gauges/schema/OTEL streams and the Done summary.

nodes.name: application-flow.md
nodes.summary: Internal architecture doc describing the end-to-end application data flow through the generator, from parse_args through component generation to combine/gauges/OTEL emission.

nodes.name: topology.md
nodes.summary: Internal architecture doc describing the TOPOLOGY graph: edge types, weight semantics, saturation parameters, and the realistic-mode generation order.

nodes.name: test_amc_module_load_lint.py
nodes.summary: Enforces the tools/check_amc_module_load.py pre-commit hook contract: scans tests/ for spec_from_file_location calls bypassing the conftest amc fixture and asserts the hook flags them.

nodes.name: test_args.py
nodes.summary: Argparse-only coverage for parse_args: defaults, custom values, invalid combinations, mutually exclusive flag groups, and per-flag accept/reject behavior for every CLI surface.

nodes.name: test_cascades.py
nodes.summary: Behavioral tests for register_cascade helper and the cascade application path inside generate_component.

nodes.name: test_instance_config.py
nodes.summary: Schema and loader tests for --instance-config: YAML/JSON parsing, PyYAML lazy import, field validation, error wrapping with file-path prefix, partial-config fallback to anonymous defaults.

nodes.name: test_instance_filter.py
nodes.summary: Phase 4 instance_filter coverage: accepted forms (None, iterable of ids, callable predicate), zero-match WARNING behavior, and per-pod anomaly cell verification on multi-instance runs.

nodes.name: test_instances.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Instance dataclass: frozen, all-None default, accepts all six declared fields, validates INSTANCES registry coverage and shape.

nodes.name: test_otlp_units.py
nodes.summary: OTLP unit-conversion tests: _dt_to_unix_nanos, OTLP payload builder shapes, attribute emission, and the byte-level invariant that header/dimension attributes serialize as string-typed AnyValue entries.

nodes.name: test_phase7_partial_outage.py
nodes.summary: Phase 7 multi-instance partial-outage tests verifying per-pod isolation: a slow upstream pod's saturation feedback should reach only the matched downstream pod, leaving siblings on the natural baseline.

nodes.name: test_scenario_deviation.py
nodes.summary: Phase 9 regression guard: for every Scenario, compares the active CSV against an --exclude-scenarios <slug> baseline (zero anomalies fired) and asserts every recorded anomaly row deviates by >1σ from the natural band.

nodes.name: test_scenarios.py
nodes.summary: Largest test file (1837 lines, 111 functions): in-process scenario composition matrix covering allowlist x exclude x signal-level x duration x components, validation errors, WARNING emission, default-equivalence byte hashes, anomaly-count sampling, and shape/timing locks.

nodes.name: test_topology_loadbalancer_gateway.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end topology tests pinning the loadbalancer -> apigateway coupling under realistic mode: byte-identity to default, coupling lift over independent mode, locked SHA-256 hashes for the pre-flag-day independent baseline.

nodes.name: test_topology_registry.py
nodes.summary: Import-time validator coverage for TOPOLOGY: dict-of-list shape, edge target membership, v1 graph presence, callable weight smoke tests, signal callable requirement, correlation_threshold ranges, SaturationParams validation, cycle rejection.

nodes.name: check_amc_module_load.py
nodes.summary: Pre-commit hook scanning tests/ files for importlib.util.spec_from_file_location calls that bypass the session-scoped amc fixture in conftest. AST-based scanner tracks local aliases and noqa annotations; flags naked calls so duplicated module loads do not balloon test memory.

nodes.name: _collect_noqa_lines
nodes.summary: Scans a file for # noqa: amc-load annotations, returning the line numbers the hook should treat as authorized escapes from the no-direct-spec-load rule.

nodes.name: _collect_local_aliases
nodes.summary: AST walker collecting local-name bindings for importlib.util.spec_from_file_location so the scanner can detect aliased calls in addition to the canonical attribute-access form.

nodes.name: _value_resolves_to_fn
nodes.summary: Predicate testing whether an ast Name/Attribute node resolves to the tracked spec_from_file_location alias set.

layers.name: Generator Core
layers.description: The single-script generator (`anomaly-metric-creator.py`) that hosts the MetricSpec catalog, RunContext, CLI parser, vectorized `generate_component()` pipeline, topology coupling and saturation math, scenario/anomaly engine, CSV/schema/gauges writers, OTEL/OTLP streaming, and the `--validate-output` validator — i.e. every line of production code in the project.

layers.name: Test Suite
layers.description: Pytest modules under `tests/` (driven by the session-scoped `conftest.py` fixtures) that exercise the generator end-to-end: registry lockstep, RNG determinism, CLI parsing, scenario composition, topology coupling/saturation/multi-instance behavior, schema/validator/combine/gauges artifacts, OTEL emission, and locked SHA-256 golden hashes at 1-day and 7-day durations.

layers.name: Developer Tooling
layers.description: Custom developer-tooling scripts invoked outside the test runner — currently the `amc-no-direct-spec-load` pre-commit hook that scans `tests/` for direct `importlib.util.spec_from_file_location` reloads of the generator module.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Human-facing project docs: `README.md` (CLI reference and anomaly catalog), `CLAUDE.md` (canonical architecture and pre-PR checklist), `AGENTS.md` (pointer to CLAUDE.md), and the `docs/` deep-dives covering topology coupling and end-to-end application flow.

layers.name: Project Configuration
layers.description: Build and quality-gate configuration: `pyproject.toml` (package metadata, pytest-xdist defaults, ruff lint rules, optional `[yaml]` extra) and `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (ruff + the custom amc-module-load hook).

tour.title: What This Project Is
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the pitch: anomaly-metric-creator generates synthetic, second-by-second IoT-style telemetry for a 13-component SaaS stack, with injectable anomalies, cascading failures, a topology coupling graph, and optional OTLP emission. The README walks through CLI flags, output files, and the scenario catalog — the user-facing surface that everything else in the codebase serves.

tour.title: The Architecture Guide Behind the README
tour.description: CLAUDE.md is the canonical architecture doc — it is the file the codebase itself reads as its single source of truth, paired with AGENTS.md for contributor workflow. Where the README explains what the tool does, CLAUDE.md explains why each subsystem looks the way it does: the generation pipeline ordering, the topology coupling math, the dispatch rules for anomaly generators, and the pre-PR checklist that gates every change. Skim it now to anchor the rest of the tour.

tour.title: The Single Production File
tour.description: All production code lives in one Python file. `anomaly-metric-creator.py` hosts the dataclasses (`MetricSpec`, `Instance`, `Edge`, `Scenario`, `RunContext`), the module-level registries (`COMPONENTS`, `INSTANCES`, `SCENARIOS`, `TOPOLOGY`), the CLI parser, the vectorized generator, the topology composers, the CSV/schema/gauge writers, the OTLP streamer, and the `--validate-output` validator. Fan-out 30 in the graph confirms it: every test and tool reaches into this one module.
tour.languageLesson: Python dataclasses with `frozen=True` create immutable value objects; combined with module-level dicts they form a declarative registry pattern. Import-time validators that raise `ValueError` on registry drift turn typos and shape mismatches into fail-fast errors before `main()` ever runs.

tour.title: The Vectorized Generation Pipeline
tour.description: `generate_component()` is the heart of the script: for each component it builds `floor(total_seconds / interval)` rows in a single numpy pass, applies anomaly overrides as masked writes, runs derivations (e.g. `hit_ratio = 100 * cache_hits / (cache_hits + cache_misses)`), then writes one CSV. `_natural_column()` is its inner workhorse — `value = (base + jitter*randn) * multiplier(ts) + additive(ts)` — and accepts optional `latency_factor`, `error_offset`, `baseline_override`, and `noise` kwargs that the topology layer uses to bend the natural curve.
tour.languageLesson: Numpy vectorization rewrites a per-row Python loop as one operation over an `ndarray` of shape `(n_rows,)`. Anomalies are applied with boolean masks rather than indexed writes so the whole column stays a single contiguous buffer — this is what lets a 7-day, 13-component, second-resolution run complete in seconds.

tour.title: Scenarios and Anomaly Injection
tour.description: Anomalies are not random — they are declared in the `SCENARIOS` registry as `Scenario` objects bundling `primary_specs` (the main injection) and `cascade_specs` (downstream blast radius). `_apply_scenarios()` is the single point that populates `RunContext.component_anomalies` and `cascading_anomalies`, while `_validate_scenario_spec()` checks every spec at import time: required keys present, generator arity matches the dispatch rule (step path = `(ts, col, rng)`, span path = `(ts, col, t_within, span_idx, rng)`), `metric` exists in the full catalog, `instance_filter` shape is legal. Catch typos before generation, not after.
tour.languageLesson: Generator dispatch by required-positional count lets one registry hold functions of multiple shapes safely. Python's `inspect.signature` exposes `Parameter.kind` and default values so the validator can reject silent-misbind cases (e.g. `(ts, col, scale=1.0, *args)` on a span path) at import time instead of corrupting RNG draws at run time.

tour.title: The Topology Coupling Graph
tour.description: The `TOPOLOGY` constant declares a directed service-call graph (loadbalancer → apigateway → {auth, cache, db, llm_analytics}, cacheservice → database). Under `--topology-mode realistic` (default since phase 6), `_compose_topology_coupled_specs()` and `_compose_topology_saturation_specs()` rewrite each downstream's `MetricSpec` lambdas so its load metric is driven by the upstream's captured load, and its latency / error columns receive a logistic-shaped saturation lift. `docs/topology.md` visualizes the edges, saturation midpoints, and gain parameters that produce realistic load-driven cascades.
tour.languageLesson: A logistic curve `1 / (1 + exp(-k*(u - 1)))` saturates smoothly between 0 and 1 around `u = 1`. Mapping `u = upstream_load / midpoint` and scaling the curve by per-edge `latency_gain` and `error_gain` is a compact way to encode 'this downstream slows down and starts erroring as the upstream approaches capacity' without simulating individual requests.

tour.title: Multi-Instance Fan-Out and Per-Instance Topology
tour.description: By default each component emits one anonymous `Instance()` and the CSV stays in the historic `timestamp,m0,m1,...` shape. Passing `--instances-per-component N` or `--instance-config PATH` activates the long-form layout: each component CSV gains an `id,host,pod,az,region,tenant` prefix block and writes N copies of every row, one per instance. Under realistic mode the topology layer routes 1:1 across matched cardinalities (pod-K → pod-K) so a slow upstream pod elevates only the corresponding downstream pod — a saturation isolation property pinned by `test_topology_multi_instance.py`.
tour.languageLesson: Dispatch by the *content* of a parameter (here, whether the instance list is a single anonymous `Instance()`) rather than by a CLI flag keeps the byte-identical default path purely structural. The dim-aware long-form layout is opted into by the data, not by a mode switch, so a programmatic caller that builds a multi-instance run via `RunContext` gets the same dispatch as a CLI user.

tour.title: Output Artifacts: CSVs, Combine, Gauges, Schema
tour.description: Beyond per-component CSVs, the script emits an `anomalies.csv` manifest, an optional `combined_metrics_unified.csv` (wide layout for dimensionless input, long layout for multi-instance), an optional `gauges.csv` long-form data point file, and an optional declarative `schema.json` that catalogues every artifact, every component's MetricSpec metadata, and the active topology graph. `_pre_clean_output_dir()` consumes the `_EMIT_ARTIFACT_FILES` registry to delete stale artifacts from prior runs that this run will not regenerate — the single source of truth so the cleanup, the end-of-run summary, and the validator can never drift.
tour.languageLesson: `heapq.merge` lazily k-way-merges sorted iterators without loading them into memory. The gauges and combine long-form writers use it across one open file handle per `(component, instance)` source — `_ensure_long_form_fd_capacity` raises `RLIMIT_NOFILE` ahead of time so a 13-component × 20-instance fan-out (260 handles) does not trip macOS's default 256-handle soft limit mid-write.

tour.title: OpenTelemetry Streaming
tour.description: When `--otel-enabled` is set, `stream_otel_gauges` and `stream_otel_signals` walk the same per-component CSVs as the file writers and emit OTLP data points (HTTP/JSON or protobuf). Each non-empty dimension cell (`id`, `host`, `pod`, `az`, `region`, `tenant`) becomes a string attribute on every data point, so a multi-instance run produces per-pod observability without any extra config. `_iter_component_rows` is the shared reader that decides — by header inspection — whether each row carries a dimension prefix.
tour.languageLesson: OTLP gauge data points are `(timestamp, value, attributes)` triples. The protobuf and JSON payload builders here share one dimension-attribute pipeline so hand-crafted test batches and live CSV-driven streams emit byte-identical attribute sets — a deliberate single-source-of-truth choice that catches drift between the two encodings.

tour.title: Self-Validation: `--validate-output`
tour.description: `--validate-output PATH` is a standalone mode (peer of `--combine-only`) that loads `PATH/schema.json` and re-checks every artifact in the directory: required files present, no unknown files, manifest sorted, row counts within an 8-sigma band, timestamps in range, cells inside declared `[min_value, max_value]` bounds and dtype-correct, derivations recomputed within tolerance, long-form headers correct under multi-instance, and topology coupling correlations meet their per-edge Pearson threshold. The validator is the system's executable specification — every guarantee the generator makes is checked here.
tour.languageLesson: Strict dispatch tables (`_RECOMPUTERS[component]` not `_RECOMPUTERS.get(component)`) turn registry drift into a loud `KeyError` rather than a silent `None`. The pre-PR checklist in CLAUDE.md explicitly names `table.get(key)` on dispatch tables as an antipattern — it's the difference between a typo failing one assertion and a typo silently passing every check.

tour.title: Tests, Fixtures, and Tooling
tour.description: The test suite is the load-bearing safety net: 30 test files all import a single `tests/conftest.py` (fan-in 21, the highest in the graph) that lazily loads the `anomaly-metric-creator.py` module via `_load_amc`, defines the `run_capture` helper, and provides session-scoped 1-day, 7-day, and N=3 datasets so the suite stays under a 10-minute budget at `-n 4` parallelism. `tools/check_amc_module_load.py` is a pre-commit hook that structurally rejects new test files re-importing the module directly — the kind of guard that catches the duplicate-fixture pattern before review.
tour.languageLesson: `pytest-xdist`'s `--dist loadfile` keeps every test in a file on the same worker, which lets session-scoped fixtures (here: full-day generations) be instantiated at most once per worker per file. Combined with per-test `tmp_path` isolation and explicit `--seed` on every `main()` call, the suite stays order-independent under parallel execution — a property the CI budget depends on.
